title: the bare A -> B transition shorthand, rejected by design
note: Rejected deliberately: bare A -> B is indistinguishable from a -> function-operation expression (sysml.langium:207-209). The agent must be told to write `transition`.

expectFail.reason: The bare `A -> B` shorthand is rejected by design, but the diagnostic does not name the required `transition` keyword, so the agent cannot derive the repair from the message.
